summary_1line: Bhima defeats and captures Susarman during the cattle raid battle; Yudhishthira orders mercy, Virata rewards the Pandavas, and news of victory is sent to the city.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima leaps from his chariot, seizes King Susarman by the hair, and slams him to the ground like a lion overpowering a deer.
Bhima binds the dust-covered and unconscious Susarman and throws him onto his chariot before presenting the captive king to Yudhishthira.
King Virata, surrounded by warriors, offers gems, cattle, and wealth to the Pandavas in gratitude for rescuing his kingdom.
